description: Pattern: an Agent-profile direct room with EGDESK_AGENT_RELOAD_REUSE on (L7 c27). Three turns on one thread. The first Agent turn after the start reloads once and records the parameters it loaded with (turn 2 is not asserted: its counts are recorded); the THIRD turn, with nothing changed, must skip the detach and resume: expect.resumes 0 and unsubscribes 0. Turn 1 has no resume (a new thread). The records carry engineRequests per turn, so the real counts are visible even where an expectation does not pin them. Needs --persisted-with-cleanup (a direct room is not one-time); no Decision model is needed.
